title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Blueberry Raspberries Pre-Filled Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Dive into a lush, tangy combination of Blueberries and Raspberries in these SKE Crystal 4in1 prefilled pods. This flavour merges the richness of blueberries with the ruby tang of fresh raspberries, offering a sublime MTL vaping experience. The Nic-Salt formulation vape juice ensures a smooth and flavourful vape. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods replicate the popular flavours of SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes in a more cost-effective and eco-friendly format. Designed for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these easy-to-use pods fit seamlessly into the device's rotating mechanism, allowing you to enjoy four flavours in one handy vape kit.
